يعتطفا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَطِفَا (yaʕtaṭifā) /jaʕ.ta.tˤi.faː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# يُعْتَطَفَا (yuʕtaṭafā) /juʕ.ta.tˤa.faː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
